messages:
maria: Publishing job for `gcr.cn-northwest` mirror failed during provenance attach, deploybot returned 422. CI shows a timestamp skew error. Can we triage?
aj: saw it too, log pasted below. looks like the attestation timestamp is slightly ahead of manifest timestamp, causing our provenance guard to reject.
ken: can you paste the exact error?
maria: error snippet:
```
Error: provenance_attach_failed
  reason: attestation_timestamp > manifest_timestamp + allowed_skew (25s)
  manifest_digest: sha256:abc123...
  attestation_time: 2024-06-15T14:23:05Z
  manifest_time: 2024-06-15T14:22:40Z
  delta: 25s
  code: 422
```
maria: CI pipeline uses container-builder in asia region forwarding to EU mirror; I suspect clock drift on the build agent or mediate GCR signed manifest canonicalization changed ordering.
deploybot: @maria publish blocked: provenance validation failed for tag `release/v1.12.0` in region `eu-west1`. Fallback: not publishing to mirrored registries.
ci-bot: Build agents were recently rotated -> image-builder-7 had NTP jitter alerts at 14:22. Ops ticket #3482.
sre-ops: confirmed: image-builder-7 host clock offset +27s vs ntp.pool. Reached out to infra to re-sync.
aj: if we resync and re-run the attach step, will we get same attestation timestamp or will signing service stamp with wall-clock?
ken: our attestation service takes provider time (sigservice), which usually has stable NTP. The weird bit is manifest_time is set by GCR on upload; sometimes manifest_time comes from the push client time if the registry accepts it.
leo: impact? are any canaries live with this image?
maria: canary in us-west got the image earlier via direct push (not mirrored); eu canary is blocked. Rolling release paused. No user-facing incidents yet.
aj: two immediate options: 1) retag and republish the image from a healthy agent so manifest_time >= attestation_time; 2) push a fix to provenance guard to allow slack (but that's risky).
ken: prefer option 1. Retag with a new build-id-based tag (e.g., `v1.12.0+republish.1`) and attach provenance after resync. Need a short change window because republish will trigger mirror TTLs.
leo: agree. schedule a 30m change window for the EU mirror republish at 14:40 UTC. Notify customers with pinned-digest rollback plan in release notes if anything goes wrong.
sre-ops: I'll allocate on-call infra to re-sync NTP across builders and kick the republish.
ci-bot: command to retag and re-push (run from a synced builder):
```
# fetch existing digest
DIGEST=sha256:abc123...
# create new tag locally and push
gcloud auth configure-docker eu.gcr.io
docker pull eu.gcr.io/project/image@$DIGEST
docker tag eu.gcr.io/project/image@$DIGEST eu.gcr.io/project/image:v1.12.0-republish1
docker push eu.gcr.io/project/image:v1.12.0-republish1
# then attach provenance via sigservice
sigservice attach --image eu.gcr.io/project/image:v1.12.0-republish1 --attest
```
ci-bot: note: use `--no-timestamp-override` so attestation uses sigservice time after builder NTP fix.
aj: action items: 1) @sre-ops re-sync builders (in progress), 2) @maria run retag+push from builder-9 once synced, 3) @ken monitor deploybot for successful attach, 4) @leo update release notes with republish entry and pinned-digest fallback.
deploybot: will unblock automatically once provenance attach succeeds for the new tag.
sre-ops: NTP resync scheduled, applying to image-builder-7/8/9 now. ETA 10m.
maria: I'll prep release note snippet: "Republished release/v1.12.0 as v1.12.0-republish1 due to cross-region provenance timestamp skew; canaries paused for EU until attach confirmed. Pinned digest rollback available: sha256:abc123..."
leo: add an instruction to ops runbook: if provenance attach fails with skew <=30s, prefer republish instead of widening guard.
aj: quick follow-up: can we add a pre-attach check in CI to compare builder clock vs sigservice before starting signing? saves this pain.
ken: good idea. I'll open a small ticket for that during the change window.
maria: republish started from builder-9 at 14:36 UTC (attempt 1).
ci-bot: push logs: `push complete`, `attestation request sent`, waiting for sigservice.
ci-bot: sigservice response: attest_ok, attach completed.
deploybot: publish success: mirrored registries updated for tag `v1.12.0-republish1`, EU mirror now has image and provenance. Canary resumed. :white_check_mark:
leo: closing plan. maria, pls add final note to the release notes and close ops ticket #3482 when NTP drift mitigations are landed.
maria: will do. thanks all. :tada:
